_comment: Multilingual KG-search eval fixture (ADR 0135 KG-search F3-lift amendment, Slice 1d). Per language: a small corpus of property-management documents (the domain) + queries with their ground-truth relevant doc ids. Used by kg_eval.py to measure per-language recall@k + nDCG@k with the REAL BGE-M3 embedder (+ optional bge-reranker rescore). Deliberately small (the de-risk spike measured latency at scale; THIS measures retrieval QUALITY across languages — the multilingual claim). Ground truth is a hand-labeled relevance set per query.
